title: Call 2: unrecognised card payments, recently bereaved (draft: Sultan to check)

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Thistle Bank, Sam speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hi. There's a payment on my card I don't recognise, eighty-nine ninety-nine to a company called Brightline Media, and it's the second month running. I'm honestly fed up with it.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I can look into that for you. Can I take your full name and date of birth first, please?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you, Daniel. And the first line of your address?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Lovely, that's all verified. I can see two payments to Brightline Media, on the 3rd of September and the 3rd of October.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Sorry, I'm a bit all over the place at the moment. My wife passed away in August and she always looked after the bills.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Oh, I'm so sorry to hear that.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Yes, I'll cancel the card, order you a new one and pop a note on the account. I'll raise a dispute with the merchant as well.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: And will I get the money back?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Disputes can take a little while. You should hear back from us within eight weeks.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Is there anything else I can help with today?

expected.notes: Subtle on purpose. C1: 'fed up', second month: dissatisfaction, but 'a note on the account' is not logging a complaint. C2: sympathy without support is not enough. S1/S3: a card payment dispute is a payment-services complaint: 15 business days, not 8 weeks. C3 passes: no outcome promised.
